needs.what: a one-shot op that grants a pay_generic_with currency (convoke, i.e. tap_creatures) to the next spell a player casts this turn, consumed by that cast -- the next_spell shape of grant_flash_permission / next_spell_cost_reduction / uncounterable_this_turn, but handing over a pay_generic_with currency
